diagnosis: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, NOS; GCB phenotype by Hans algorithm because CD10 is positive.
stage: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage IV because kidney, adrenal, and liver involvement are non-lymphatic extranodal sites; bone marrow is negative, but marrow involvement is not required for stage IV when disseminated extranodal organ disease is present.
biology: Not double-expressor lymphoma because MYC 20% and BCL2 30% are below common IHC thresholds. Not double-hit lymphoma because MYC, BCL2, and BCL6 rearrangements are negative by FISH.
prognosis: Use IPI and CNS-IPI. IPI is high risk with age over 60, stage IV, elevated LDH, ECOG 2, and multiple extranodal sites.
first_line_treatment: Curative-intent immunochemotherapy if organ function permits. Pola-R-CHP or R-CHOP are appropriate first-line options; DA-EPOCH-R is not required by double-hit biology because FISH is negative.
cns_risk: High CNS relapse risk by CNS-IPI because of kidney/adrenal involvement plus age over 60, stage IV, elevated LDH, ECOG 2, and multiple extranodal sites. CNS staging and prophylaxis should be strongly considered; renal function affects high-dose methotrexate feasibility.
response_assessment: Use FDG PET-CT with Lugano/Deauville criteria, especially end-of-treatment PET.
missing_information: CSF cytology/flow if CNS staging is pursued
cardiac function and viral serologies before immunochemotherapy
